article.title: Relocated Hypocenters and Structural Analysis from Waveform Modeling of Aftershocks from the 2011 Prague, Oklahoma, Earthquake Sequence
article.journal: Bulletin of the Seismological Society of America
article.scientific_question: Use a selected set of relocated aftershocks and waveform modeling to assess focal depths and explain strong S-wave coda scattering in the Prague sequence.
article.sequence: 2011 Prague, Oklahoma earthquake sequence; Table S3 contains selected M_L>3 aftershocks.
article.catalog_relationship: Table S3 is a 13-event manually picked/relocalized structural anchor, not a complete sequence catalog.

product_semantics.event_id_rule: `no` is article row number only; not a cross-catalog event ID.

catalog.quality_tier_detail: Selective high-quality absolute/depth locations; not a complete event-existence catalog.

construction_workflow.summary: Selected M_L>3 aftershocks are manually picked on 19 nearby stations, relocated with HYPOINVERSE 2000 using a gradient 1-D model, and exported as Table S3; 2-D sofi2D modeling is downstream interpretation.

input_data.name: ZQ/RAMP and LA waveforms
input_data.provider_or_network: IRIS ZQ/RAMP and USGS Pasadena LA array
input_data.channels_sampling: Three-component observations; exact station table in missing electronic supplement
input_data.availability_conditions: 19 available local stations used for relocation.

input_data.name: 1-D gradient velocity model
input_data.availability_conditions: Exact model/S1 metadata not staged locally.

stages.name: manual event selection and P/S picking
stages.purpose: Select clearly recorded M_L>3 aftershocks and obtain phase arrivals.
outputs: 25–34 P/S arrivals per event for 13 events
stages.method: Manual P and S picks at available local stations.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Selection is sparse/manual; no automatic completeness threshold published.
stages.dependencies: Local station coverage and clear arrivals.

evidence.locator: Starting population and selection; Phase picking and location

stages.name: HYPOINVERSE relocation
outputs: Table S3 origins, errors, RMS and Mw
stages.method: HYPOINVERSE 2000 inversion/relocation; velocity varied within model constraints.
qc_and_rejection_rules: RMS residuals and reported error fields retained; exact ERH/ERZ interpretation unresolved.
stages.dependencies: Manual picks, station geometry, velocity model.

evidence.locator: Phase picking and location; Table S3 product and field semantics

stages.name: 2-D waveform modeling
stages.method: Finite-difference waveform modeling; not an event inclusion rule.
qc_and_rejection_rules: Do not count synthetic/model outputs as catalog rows.

construction_workflow.final_output: 13-row selective relocation table; seven rows overlap Prague v1 core window.

related_products.name: Electronic station/velocity supplements
related_products.catalog_relation: Needed to reproduce station geometry and velocity assumptions.

evidence.locator: Observation and network conditions; Local provenance and unresolved actions

scientific_findings.statement: The 13 relocated events provide a sparse structural/depth anchor, not a completeness catalog.
scientific_findings.depends_on: Manual event selection and local relocation

benchmark_context.recommended_role: Matched-event depth/location sanity checks and structural geometry.
benchmark_context.comparison_or_baseline_sources: Cross-match to Cochran/McMahon by time/space tolerance, never row number.
benchmark_context.valid_comparisons: Matched-event origin time, epicenter, depth, ERH/ERZ-aware residuals.
benchmark_context.caveats: No recall/event-rate denominator; table row number is not stable ID.
